description:
Get ready to till the soil and reap the rewards in Farmer Pedro!

In this charming 3D farming simulator, you’ll take on the role of Pedro, a humble farmer with a big dream - to build the most bountiful farm in the countryside. Start by driving your trusty tractor around the initial plot of land, harvesting a variety of crops like corn, tomatoes, carrots, and more.

As you grow and harvest your crops, you’ll earn cash that can be used to expand your farmland and unlock access to new crops.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
In "Car Mechanic Simulator 2025", you are a master restorer who breathes new life into forgotten cars! 

Your task is to find old, broken, and abandoned cars, disassemble them down to the last screw, repair them, replace parts, and reassemble them, turning rusty piles of metal into shiny legends of the automotive industry. Search for rare spare parts, restore engines, choose the perfect paint, and bring every detail to perfection.

title: Maze Escape Challenge
description: Maze Escape Challenge is a fast-paced maze game where you must reach the exit as quickly as possible. Each level features a unique labyrinth with increasing difficulty, traps, and surprises. Some levels include Dark Mode, where you can see only a small light around the player. Earn stars by finishing mazes fast (1–3 stars), unlock new levels, beat your best times, and try to master every maze.

title: Candy Maker: Dessert Games
description: Do you like match-3 games, candies, and delicious cakes? Solve sweet riddles, move puzzles, and collect culinary masterpieces! Train your brain by solving exciting puzzles! Rich graphics and pleasant music will help you relax to your advantage!

title: Brainrot Evolution
description: Welcome to the world of meme Italian animals - a dynamic arcade game where you control unique creatures, destroy the environment, gather resources, and unlock new animals. Your goal is to evolve and progress further, unlocking more and more unusual meme beasts. Help yourself with pets: each one provides advantages and strengthens your character. Explore levels, destroy objects, collect useful resources, and unlock the next stage of evolution.

title: Online Cats Multiplayer Park
description: Come to run, jump, guess, and race as a cute but competitive kitty in Online Cats - Multiplayer Park. It’s a real-time multiplayer chaos arena. Here are seven modes you can choose from. In Grab A Shabby Ball, for example, you will have to compete with your opponents and try to touch the ball to get points.

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Froggy Hop
description: Froggy Hop is a fun, physics-based game where you launch a bouncy frog and help it travel across lily pads, turtles, and spring pads while dodging obstacles. Upgrade jump power, height, and bounce to go farther. Unlock cool skins with upgrades, complete daily missions, and aim for the best distance!

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Lost Adventure
description: Lost Adventure is a survival puzzle game where you guide a determined pilot through a strange, untamed land after a mid-air crash. Craft tools, mine resources, and solve clever challenges as you race to rescue scattered passengers. Your choices shape their fate—will you lead them to safety before the wilderness claims them for good?

title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
description:
Build and manage your own cinema empire! 
Unlock movie rooms, snack and burger corners to attract more customers.
Hire staff, upgrade facilities, and keep your theater running smoothly.
Earn cash even while you’re offline and grow your business.
Become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

title: Cargo Skates
description:
No obstacles, no matter how high, can stop me from collecting more goods.
Pass the obstacles and finally collect enough goods.
Now, your supermarket can open

title: BitGoblins RPG Simulator
description:
Become the protector of the kingdom from goblin robbers!

Get stronger by fighting goblin armies! Upgrade your hero with every battle, earn gold and get new items

Defeat the leaders of the goblins - the ogres! Gain strength after fighting goblin armies and test your skills

Explore the possibilities of this game! Start as a young wizard and upgrade your abilities, get new equipment and become the menace of goblins.

title: Sprunki Coloring Book
description:
Dive into a colorful adventure with Sprunki Coloring Book, a delightful game designed for kids and adults alike. Choose from a wide variety of adorable Sprunki characters, captivating landscapes, and fun designs to color your way. Whether you're a budding artist or simply looking to relax, Sprunki Coloring Book offers endless possibilities for self-expression.
Start coloring today and discover the joy of creativity with Sprunki Coloring Book!

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Sniper 3D Zombie
description: Defend your position from the zombie invasion. You have a sniper rifle, find and eliminate zombies. Hitting a zombie is not difficult, it is much more difficult to detect it. The enemies are cunning and very well disguised, they are able to blend in with the environment. Shoot the zombies and take the first places in the leaderboard!

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Simon Super Rabbit
description:
Simon and his friends have turned into superheroes and now they must look for the evil Professor Wolf and get their marbles back.
Grrr… That boastful and braggart Professor Wolf and his minions don’t want to give the marbles back to Simon and they have challenged him to a super mega competition which he must win to get them back. If you beat him, he will be giving the marbles back to you. Surely you can win and get them all back. Go for it!

title: Elemental Gloves Magic Power
description: Elemental Gloves - Magic Power is a superpower arcade game.  Experience the fun of superpowers in magic games? Fascinated by elemental games? In this game, you can use the superpowers in the magic gloves to fight with your enemies. Shooting with flames, attacking with lightning, and attacking with electromagnetic waves, are three ways for you to choose. Don't hesitate to take the opportunity to practice real elemental magic and wipe out the bad guys. Become the greatest elemental master!

title: Unpuzzle Master
description:
Unpuzzle master plan and execute your moves strategically to become the master, navigating through bottlenecks and utilizing “exit” strategies effectively.

Touch the tile to move it in the direction of the tile. Complete each level that really challenges your brain to think sharper.

Choose from a variety of themes and skins to customize your block-puzzle adventure. Each skin not only changes the visual aesthetic but also improves the way you interact with the puzzles, making every move count.

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.

title: Epic Mine
description: In the game, you will need to correctly organize the smelting of resources in order to sell everything as profitably as possible. At the same time, it is important not to forget that resources should also be spent on skill upgrades! The game values quick reactions, but the ability to earn well will allow you to overcome any difficult spot in the game with patience and intelligence.

title: Color Block Jam 2
description: Play Color Block Jam 2 free online in your browser with no download and no install required. This free online puzzle game lets you slide colorful blocks into matching gates through smart logic levels designed to test your brain and timing. Perfect for fans of cool math games, unblocked games, and quick school breaks, it loads fast and works smoothly on desktop and mobile. Enjoy relaxing color block puzzles anytime, anywhere, completely free.

title: 100 Rooms Escape
description: This is a brain-burning and challenging escape room online game. Interesting gameplay so you won't get bored. You need to open 100 doors to escape the room. Interact with objects and solve puzzles to complete the tasks in the escape game. Solve the puzzles, and take inventory of the hidden items. You may use them to open the room, move on to the next level, use your skills, and do whatever it takes to escape.

title: Fix The Hoof
description: Fix The Hoof is a soothing simulation game where you take on the role of a hoof care specialist, restoring and beautifying the hooves of animals like horses, cows, and goats. Enjoy deeply satisfying ASMR moments as you clean, polish, and paint hooves in this engaging 3D experience. Earn money from your services to upgrade your farm and expand your collection of animals to care for.

title: Count Master Match Color Run
description: Count Master: Match Color Run is a colorful running game where you lead a group of little characters in a color-matching race! In this exciting arcade challenge, collect characters of the same color to grow your team. Merge them for a bigger squad, aiming for the highest score. Avoid hammers, spikes, etc. Collect characters of the same color to expand your team.

title: Qube 2048
description: We present a unique arcade game that combines the dynamic gameplay of Q*bert and the mechanics of 2048!  You start with the number 2 and move across a grid of blocks, doubling its value. The goal is to reach the maximum number by planning your moves and avoiding obstacles.

title: Mini Games Casual Collection
description:
Mini Games: Casual Collection is an online game. The gameplay is simple, fun, and addictive, so
you won't be able to stop playing. There is no stamina display. You can play anytime anywhere. You can use hints to help you pass when you are stuck on a level. If you have any problems playing this game or have any suggestions for this game, please leave us a message. If you like our games, please share them with your friends to double the fun!

title: Miner's Fury!
description:
Miner's Fury! Avoid and destroy!

Clear and destroy rock waves. Lookout for mystery rocks too! Buy and deploy Turrets to breeze through levels. 
Collect the coins that drop from the destroyed rocks, and spend them buying Turrets, and to Upgrade yourself. Upgrades will make you deal more damage faster, earn more coins, as well as improving your spawned Turrets.
Lookout for Missions to earn rewards!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Super Brain
description: In the game, you'll control a character sprinting down a track, but your path is blocked by a series of "Gates of Knowledge." Each gate presents an interesting question, and you must choose the lane corresponding to the correct answer in a short amount of time to pass through. A wrong choice ends the run! As you get faster, the questions become trickier. This game tests not only your knowledge but also your on-the-spot reaction skills. Come join this dual challenge of brain and speed!

title: Bomb Head Hot Potato
description:
In the game "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" your goal is to stay alive and not die from the bomb in your hand. Drop bombs on your opponents to win! 
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" and prove your survival skills and tactical thinking!

title: Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat
description: Ever wanted to experience life as a mischievous cat? In Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat, you take on the role of a playful yet naughty kitty, causing absolute mayhem inside Grandma’s house—all from a first-person perspective! This exciting 3D simulation game lets you see through the eyes of a troublemaking feline as you knock over furniture, scratch walls, and do everything in your power to drive Grandma crazy! Are you ready to embrace the chaos?

title: Pin Detective
description:
Welcome to Pin Detective - Mystery Mansion!
A rich woman mysteriously vanished in a lavish mansion that was covered by the rumors of ghosts and dangerous monsters. A talented detective is committed to uncovering the mystery.
By pulling the pin, you can collect clues that enlighten the truth. What happens to the billionaire? Why do the biological laboratory and so many alien animals exist in this mansion? Let’s use your brain to solve the puzzle to find it out.

title: Hexa Sort Master
description:
Let's sort some hexa blocks on the hexa tiles. Hexa blocks consist of colorful pieces. Place the same colored pieces side by side and match them to stack all hexas over one tile.
A great puzzle game begins with colorful hexa blocks! Sort the stacks side by side and try to destroy them making hexa towers. Match the same colors with each other. Exercise and improve your brain skills. More than 200 levels are waiting for you!

title: Bus Stop Color Jam
description: A great passenger color sorting game begins with the Bus Stop Color Jam game! Sort the passengers by their color and get them into the buses. Once the buses are full, they will move to the destination point. Use power-ups when you need them. Over 400+ game levels are waiting for you! An entertaining Bus Stop Jam is beginning!

title: Letters Match
description: Letters Match combines the best of the games you love. This is a mixture of matching games, word search and clearing the playing field. We took all these ingredients and spiced it up with exciting gameplay. If you like to stretch your brain with puzzles, then Letters Match is what you need!

title: Construction Truck: Building Games for Kids
description: A vibrant and engaging construction game where kids can build houses, drive vehicles, and explore a world of fun activities. With easy-to-follow instructions, children learn new words, develop skills, and enjoy creative play in a safe, interactive environment.

title: Cute cat's adventures
description: An adventure game for girls about a cat, with whom you have to go in search of kittens. Colorful levels await you, filled with traps, obstacles and secrets, as well as dangerous enemies who will try to prevent you from completing your main goal.

title: Space Shooter - Speed Typing Challenge
description:
Get ready for an exciting space adventure that helps you improve your typing skills! In this free educational online word game, you'll pilot a spaceship and face waves of enemies.

It's a fun way to boost your typing speed and accuracy. Jump into your spaceship, start typing, and help save the galaxy one word at a time!

Think you're the fastest typist in the galaxy? Prove it! The universe is counting on you - start your adventure now and become the ultimate space hero!

title: Speed Run 3d
description: Race through glowing 3D tunnels in a fast, reflex-based runner. Read the patterns, react in a split second, and thread the gaps as speed ramps up. Simple one-touch controls keep the focus on pure flow while crisp neon visuals make every run feel clean and satisfying.

title: Love Archer
description: Welcome to "Love Archer" - an addictive game where you, as the cheerful Cupid, use your archery skills to bring together all the lovers! Solve puzzles, throw arrows at creatures, and they will find themselves in a magical garden, possessed by love. Are you ready, little hero? Shoot arrows of love to create different loving couples. Even an orc and a human can become happy parents. Combine them and watch love win!

title: BlowUp ATM
description: BlowUp ATM – The ultimate heist action game where you become a master thief! Your mission? Plant explosives, blow up ATMs, and grab as much cash as you can before escaping! But beware – the cops are always on high alert!

title: Backrooms Skibidi terrors
description:
Backrooms Skibidi Toilet Terrors is an action terror game, run and grab the coin.
Avoid skibidi toilet and try to escape! only few people can survive

title: Mutant Assassin 3D
description: In the action-packed game “Mutant Assassin 3D,” you become a skilled special agent. Armed with web-launching abilities, you take on bad guys across diverse terrains. Your mission: eliminate all foes by ensnaring them with your webs and delivering powerful punches. As you progress through 4 levels, prepare for the ultimate challenge: the boss level. No hints here—navigate the best route to victory on your own. Good luck!

title: Brain Find Can You Find It
description: Brain Find brings new brain puzzles! Combine brain power and discovery for a brain challenge like no other! You can use your brain and reverse thinking to get the final target item. The unexpected way of passing levels can bring you endless laughs.  The game tests your logical thinking skills, reflexes as well as memory and creativity. Come and experience it and prove that you are the smartest!

title: Cleaning Princess
description: This is an ASMR game for girls. If you like to clean everything, our game is right for you. The game has 5 modes: ear cleaning, heel cleaning, back spa, teeth cleaning, and fan cleaning. You can use different tools to clean and massage your body parts. But it is important to note that each mode has a countdown time and you must choose the right tool to do the cleaning.

title: Reach 2048
description: The classic 2048 puzzle — slide numbered tiles on a grid, merge them, and reach the legendary 2048 tile! Simple to learn, impossible to put down. Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Save my Hero
description:
Players may enjoy a unique gaming experience in Save my Hero Online, an engaging puzzle game that revolves on drawing lines. You take on the role of a superhero under assault from missiles in the game. It is your responsibility to create lines to stop these projectiles and shield the hero.

Finish every level and attempt to rescue the superheroes, such as Iron Man, Batman, Spider-Man, and so on.

title: Obstacle Car Driving
description:
Obstacle Car Driving is an exciting and challenging endless driving game where precision and reflexes are key! Navigate through four unique environments, each packed with unpredictable obstacles that will test your driving skills.
Choose from four different cars, each with its own handling and performance, and collect in-game currency as you drive. Use your earnings to unlock new vehicles and themes

title: Xmas Hexa Sort
description:
Xmas Hexa Sort is a festive twist on the classic hexagon puzzle!
Move and place colorful stacks of blocks on the board to create perfect combinations and clear space. Relax, think ahead, and enjoy the cozy holiday atmosphere as you solve each cheerful puzzle!

title: Chicken Wild Run
description: Aim for the goal while collecting coins! Tap to change direction left and right. When your stamina runs out, the game is over. Get a kiss from a cute girl and become invincible! In invincible mode, you can bounce off obstacles. If you collect 10 mysterious bottles, the coins on the road will turn into high-scoring diamonds for a certain period of time.

title: Farm Mahjong 3D
description: Have you ever imagined playing your favorite 3D mahjong game in a farm setting? Mahjong 3D Farm does just that! It brings the popular Mahjong 3D game into the charming world of farms, filled with adorable animals, crops, and farming tools for you to match! So why wait? Play Mahjong 3D Farm Connect now and solve the puzzle amidst the fields!

title: Roblox Halloween Costume Party
description: Roblox Halloween Costume Party is the ultimate dress-up experience! Create your spookiest, funniest, or most creative Halloween looks using a variety of Roblox-inspired costumes and accessories. Mix and match outfits to stand out at the party, and get into the Halloween spirit by competing in costume contests with friends. Show off your unique style in this festive and fun-filled game!

title: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train
description:
Welcome to the most terrifying train ride of your life!
Cho-Cho Scary Charles: Spider Train is a chilling open-world survival horror shooter where your only lifeline is a small yellow train armed with a machine gun and a whole lot of courage.
Face off against Charles — the monstrous spider-train hybrid that haunts a remote island, preying on unsuspecting humans. No one knows where he came from, but one thing is clear — he won't stop until he's fed.

title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Rebuild glorious castles in a magical Solitaire adventure! Conquer 200 levels, master 12 variants – from Klondike to Spider – and enjoy fresh mechanics that reinvent the classic. The kingdom’s fate lies in your cards – are you ready to play your way to glory?

title: Uncle Bullet 007
description:
Play as Uncle Bullet, a retired spy who’s back in the game to take down rival agents and save the day. Armed with an arsenal of bouncy bullets, you’ll use your wits and quick reflexes to outmaneuver foes and rescue hostages.

Shoot your bullets at walls, ceilings, and floors to make them bounce, ricochet, and curve around corners to hit your targets.

title: Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls
description:
Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls is an interesting parkour adventure and addictive ball game in the platform genre where orange fire ball and blue water ball running races. 

Help orange ball to get to the portal faster than the blue ball doing parkour tricks! The game is similar to mario.

Game Features:
- Multiple levels with colorful balls
- Various biomes
- Secrets in the back
- Orange fire and blue water ball skins
- The water ball girl goes through the levels with you!

title: Majestic Dragons Merge
description:
In the days of old, dragons wander the lands as the master of all. Breathe fire and plunder all the riches in Majestic Dragons!

Majestic Dragons is an idle merge game where you merge together similar objects to obtain new things. Help your baby dragons grow into fearsome, majestic beasts! Watch them roam freely across the lands and accumulate riches for you.

Do you know how to train a dragon? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Fruit Jam Master
description: Enter the juiciest and most addictive puzzle adventure ever. Enjoy a fun logic puzzle game in Fruit Jam Master. You need to help all the animals leave the grassland to win. Pay attention to the color of the food. Animals can only pass through when the food matches their own color.

title: Jewel Legend Quest
description: The most legendary quest of your life begins! Miners from all around the world have come to get their hands on these precious gems. Join them in the effort and engage in various challenges while trying to dig out as many diamonds as possible.

title: Skip Love
description: Ready for a funny, brain-teasing love adventure? Play an addictive brain teaser puzzle game in Skip Love. A funny little stickman hero trying to win the heart of his beloved while dodging all sorts of dangers! Each level has unique puzzles that make you think and laugh! Think and use your brain to overcome each challenge, helping the man overcome his sexy wife and lover. For example, help him disguise himself as a clown, disrupt, create chaos, etc.

title: FRAGEN
description:
FRAGEN offers intense gunfights and challenges! With dynamic game modes, you can test your skills in different ways and become the best shooter out there!
Are you ready to join the fight? Gear up, and prove your skills!

title: LOL Funny Dance
description: LOL Funny Dance is a hilarious 2D game where you can distort the faces of politicians and celebrities to create the funniest expressions! Drag and move different points on the image to stretch, twist, and transform their looks into ridiculous and exaggerated versions. Watch them dance and react as you manipulate their faces in real time. Play the LOL Funny Dance game now.

title: ASMR Water vs Fire
description:
Water vs Fire, upgrade your water power and damp down the fire!
And Have fun!

Upgrade your Water Power and your Amount of Canister.


- Easy intuitive controls
- Release to shoot

title: Bid Wars 1: Auction Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a smart and fearless auction tycoon? Bid Wars 1: Auction Simulator is an addictive auction and simulation game that puts you in exciting bidding wars to uncover hidden treasures! In this game, you join intense auctions for storage units, antiques, and mysterious items. Spot valuable gems, bid wisely, and sell them for huge profits! From small street auctions to luxury halls, build your empire step by step!

title: Geometry Vibes
description: Geometry Vibes is a reaction-based arcade game where you avoid obstacles, traps and spikes that come at you in waves. Your goal in the game is to keep your arrow on the route and take it as far as possible. The game includes a classic mode with levels, a race mode (2-3-4 players) where you can do multiple races, and an endless mode where you can test yourself! Geometry Vibes, where the excitement never ends, invites you to challenge...

title: Doge's Battle Royale
description: Want to join the most hilarious and action-packed survival shooting game ever? In Doge's Battle Royale, you take control of the legendary Doge. Battle on a battlefield full of guns, weapons, and crazy opponents. Defeat enemies and pick up their items. Strategize your moves, and shoot with precision to outlast your enemies in this intense Battle Royale challenge.

title: Last Ufo Defense
description:
Last UFO DefenseThe galaxy is no safe place. 
As the last UFO of your kind, you stand alone against endless waves of hostile alien forces determined to wipe you out.
Pilot your hovering warship and unleash its full potential:One UFO, endless enemies. 
Survive as long as you can with precise upgrades and tactical choices.
Face relentless alien swarms in an endless survival challenge.You are the final line of defense in a hostile galaxy.
How long can the last UFO endure?

title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
description: Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes. Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

title: Block Mine Fuse TNT
description: Free the world from Herobrine and its creepy buildings. Upgrade and drop TNT, rockets and all your power on cubic settlements.

title: Fill & Sort Puzzle
description: Fill & Sort Puzzle is a cozy puzzle game where players have to sort, stack, and pleasantlarrange household items while watching for a naughty cat who likes to make things messy!  Many small details need to be paid attention to in the levels. For example, when organizing the shoe rack, don’t forget to clean the dirty shoes before storing them. Do you need a hint? Watch the video for tips.

title: Missile Launch Master
description: Experience the thrill of Boom Missile 3D, a 3D simulation game that will test your missile skills. You will play as a missile pilot who must dodge hot air balloons and helicopters in the sky. You will also have to fly the missile over an island and hit the target before the time runs out. Boom Missile 3D is a game that combines stunning 3D graphics and smooth controls. You will feel like you are in the cockpit of a real missile. Can you complete all the missions and destroy the enemy’s base?

title: Stick: Tactics & Destruction
description: Stick: Tactics & Destruction! For fans of Stick War, Teardown, and Playground. Limited ammo, grenades, monsters, explosions. Destroy everything and win!

title: Traffic Tap Survival
description: Traffic Tap Survival is a fast-paced traffic puzzle game where every tap matters. Control busy intersections, avoid crashes, and guide cars through dangerous roads filled with obstacles and tight turns. With simple controls, challenging levels, and intense survival gameplay, this addictive traffic management game will test your timing and reflexes. Perfect for fans of car puzzle games, traffic control games, and casual brain challenges.

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Digit Shooter
description: Digit Shooter! plays like a vertical-version shooting running arcade game. With 3D green numbers, you can launch green numbers to shoot green numbers and numbered walls. You can shoot them and collect them to make your number bigger. Don't waste bullets and time on red walls while avoiding them. When you reach the finish line, try to focus on one line to shoot, then you will collect more rewards

title: Ballistic Breakthrough
description: explore lush scenes, tackle tricky obstacles, and unlock upgrades. Every level blends fun challenges with strategic boosts

title: Bubble Shooter Legend
description: Enjoy a fun shooting puzzle game in Bubble Shooter Legend. Use your shooting skills in this casual puzzle game. Your goal is to match bubbles of the same color. Make them explode and disappear to complete each level step by step. Match three or more bubbles of the same color by aiming and firing them to explode and eliminate them!

title: Belote 3in1
description:
Play 3 of the most popular card games with smart & powerful AI co-players, who won’t forget the game’s rules:
- French Belote – the original: a trick-taking game played by four players in two teams, using a 32-card deck, and featuring Ace-Ten cards. 
- Contrée – a variant of Belote with advanced bidding options.
- Coinche – a variant of Belote with even further advanced bidding options, declarations, and No Trumps & All Trump modes.

title: Journey Of Escape
description: Escape games have always been a popular genre among puzzle enthusiasts and adventure seekers. They challenge players to think critically, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets while racing against time. "Journey of Escape" is an immersive collection of escape games designed to test your intelligence

title: Find 6 Differences – Spot the Hidden Changes!
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Find 6 Differences, a fun and relaxing puzzle game! With 20 unique levels, each featuring two nearly identical images, your goal is simple: find the 6 differences before time runs out! 20 challenging levels with beautifully designed images and engaging gameplay that sharpens your attention to detail. Hint system to help you when you're stuck.

title: Bubble Shooter Pop
description: Get ready for a nostalgic blast from the past with Bubble Shooter Pop - Blast Fun, the ultimate classic bubble shooter game! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant bubbles, addictive gameplay, and endless excitement.

title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
description: Dive into Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits! Combine fruit balls in this unique blend of 2048 and billiards. Enjoy ASMR sounds, complete juicy levels, and compete with others. Master your merging skills and embark on a fun fruit-filled adventure today!

title: Yummy Trails
description: Can you help the hungry snake navigate the tastiest trail of all? The path may be tricky, but the reward is delicious. Test your brain and relax.

title: Doggo Jump
description: "Doggo Jump" is a charming hyper-casual platform game where players controls a playful puppy as it hops between platforms, collecting bones and racking up points. With simple tap-to-jump mechanics, colorful graphics, and an adorable dog character, the game is easy to pick up and addictive, making it perfect for quick gaming sessions.

title: Tangram Puzzle
description:
Tangram Puzzles is a relaxing geometric logic game where you must recreate a given shape using classic tangram pieces. The challenge trains your spatial thinking, visualization, and ability to rotate and position shapes so they perfectly fit the silhouette.

Don’t be afraid to experiment — sometimes a wrong combination in one place prevents the correct placement somewhere else.

title: Hit ball
description:
Hit ball is a fast-paced arcade game with roguelike elements, in which you fight off waves of enemies with ricocheting balls! With each shot you break through obstacles, knock down monsters and earn experience to improve your abilities.
Dozens of levels with unique traps, walls, boosting balls and dangerous bosses await you. Collect boosters, pick up abilities, regenerate health and strategize to survive the battle!

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Run N Shoot
description: You run and you shoot. That’s all you do, but this deceptively simple game mixes up the action and racks up the adrenalin with surprises round every corner to ensure you never get bored. Trigger finger itchy?

title: Flames & Fortune
description: Dive into "Flames & Fortune," a game inspired by Card Crawl, set in treacherous dungeons. Play as the Pyro-Paladin, mastering a deck of 54 cards to battle foes like goblins and dragons. Strategy determines survival and success brings gold to unlock new skills. Will you conquer the darkness for untold riches?

title: Find Objects - Hidden Item
description:
Find objects on colorful maps with links and Easter eggs!
An interesting puzzle casual indie game in the genres of "Hidden Objects" and "Find the Differences"!

Embark on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden objects and riddles await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities and magical worlds to find all the hidden objects. And in the "Spot the Difference" mode, test your attentiveness by comparing two almost identical pictures!

title: Robots Gone Wild
description:
Robots Gone Wild is a thrilling survival game in a sci-fi world with captivating visuals and intense shooting mechanics. Your goal is to escape from rogue robots and destroy them while navigating through hazardous environments.

To survive, keep upgrading your character and weapons.
Improve your armor, and unlock powerful guns to fend off waves of increasingly powerful robots. 

Engage in exciting battles, and explore beautiful environments that immerse you in the chaos of a world gone wild.

title: ChessField
description: Enter ChessField, a strategic battle chess game where classic moves meet action-packed arenas! Plan, fight, and outsmart rivals in epic chess battles across dynamic fields. Perfect for students searching cool math games, chess online challenges, or fun school break strategy. With addictive gameplay, smart tactics, and arcade-style twists, ChessField is the ultimate free kids game for fans of chess, battle chess, and strategy games.

title: Animal Royal
description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.

title: Hole Battle.io
description:
The battle between the holes is beginning in the arena! Pick your hole and join this battle! Eat fruits, planes, cars, and many things that come to mind, and grow as much as you can! Your goal is to eat things that are smaller than you and make your hole bigger than the enemy's. Avoid bigger holes and try to collect power-ups besides eatable items.
Four different great maps are waiting for you:
- 2048 Map
- World Map
- Stationary Map
- Kitchen Map

title: Mermaids Spot The Differences
description: Dive into an enchanting underwater world with "Mermaids: Spot The Differences"! Explore vibrant ocean scenes teeming with mermaids and sea creatures as you sharpen your observation skills to uncover subtle distinctions. Immerse yourself in the magic of the deep blue and embark on an adventure of keen-eyed discovery!

title: Jump In To The Plane
description: Want to feel like a super agent? Jump into a plane with your car! Race against time, perform crazy stunts, and wreak havoc in this insane game. Buckle up and put the pedal to the metal! Explore dozens of locations and vehicles. One wrong move and you're gone! Hurry, you've got a plane to catch!

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: Car Paint
description: Carpaint is a free, family-friendly HTML5 logic puzzle game and casual brain teaser featuring 30 vibrant color grid challenges. Guide colorful cars across a 3×3 board, leaving paint trails to match reference patterns. This addictive, cross-platform online puzzle works in any browser or on mobile - play now!

title: Blind Boat Shooting Master
description: Craft your raft and navigate through the colorful world. Take aim and fire to vanquish foes and gather riches. Featuring a unique comic book aesthetic and a diverse roster of over 30 characters, Raft Wars provides endless hours of fun for players of all skill levels. Dive into engaging turn-based battles against other pirates, thieves, and raft fighters as you journey across various lands and discover new territories. Dont miss out on the excitement - join the adventure today!

title: My Farm Empire
description: My Farm Empire is a fun and relaxing game that lets you create your own farm paradise on a beautiful island. You will become a farmer and grow various crops, from fruits and vegetables to flowers and herbs. You will also enjoy the stunning graphics, the smooth gameplay, and the rewarding progression system that will make you feel like a real farmer. My Farm Empire is more than just a game, it’s a lifestyle. Join the My Farm Empire today and start your farming adventure.

title: Purrfect Bakery
description: Purrfect Bakery is a cozy and heartwarming game where a sweet cat runs a bakery for cute animal customers. Serve yummy treats, unlock new adorable visitors, and enjoy the simple joy of baking and friendship!

title: Office Solitaire
description: Office Solitaire is the classic solitaire variant with the objective of collecting all the cards to the top row in suited sequences from ace to king.

title: Word Voyager
description:
Word Voyager - Embark on the ultimate quest for words,right on your touchscreen!

Solve puzzles and expand your vocabulary smoothly.

Follow Olivia, your trusty guide, as she navigates you through the gentle murmurs of an ancient library. Uncover secrets during the 'Daily Mission'. Find hidden stars that unlock new thematic categories that will take you on a odyssey through the infinite universe of words.

title: Sort Tiles
description:
Sort Tiles: Tap Away is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you move tiles, clear the board, and reveal hidden pictures. It’s simple to learn but offers endless logic challenges that keep your brain active. Perfect for fans of tile puzzles, logic games, and relaxing brain teasers.

Key Features:
Unique puzzle mechanics — move tiles in the arrow’s direction and solve logic puzzles step by step.
Hidden images — every cleared puzzle board reveals a new picture.

title: Police Chase Drifter
description:
Police Chase Drifter is a fun car game where you get to run from the police, collect money bags and reach to the finishline.
Earn money to buy more cars, fasters and enjoy the drifting.

title: Ocean Small Hospital Doctor
description: Dive into the exciting world of Ocean Small Hospital - Doctor! This casual and educational game is an absolute blast for animal lovers. In this game, you'll step into the role of a heroic doctor on a submarine-turned-hospital. Your mission? Rescue injured sea animals from the vast ocean depths. As you spot a distressed creature, quickly assemble your medical team and gear.

title: Word Game 2026
description: Immerse yourself in "Word Puzzle," a premium brain-teasing game featuring a stunning 3D animated background! Test your vocabulary and fast-thinking skills by guessing the missing letters before the thrilling 30-second timer runs out. With 100 exciting levels, neon-glassmorphism graphics, and highly addictive gameplay, this game will keep you hooked for hours. Can you become the ultimate Word Master?

title: Knife.io
description: Knife.io is a fast-paced 2D battle game where you throw knives at your enemies to eliminate them! Dodge incoming attacks, aim precisely, and take down as many opponents as possible without getting hit. With vibrant worlds to explore and tons of unique characters to unlock, every match is a colorful and action-packed challenge. Play solo or team up with a friend in local multiplayer, only the sharpest player will survive!

title: 2048 - Blocks destruction
description: 2048 - Blocks destruction is endless fun! Rules are simple: shoot balls, destroy blocks and grow numbers. Get balls with bigger numbers and reach higher scores! Get a lot of balls or merge them and increase damage drastically!

title: Plane Chase
description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!

Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

title: Wild West Match 3
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: Sorting Candy Factory
description: A great puzzle game in the sorting genre. At the candy factory, all the candies are mixed up, sort the candies into flasks so that they can be packed and shipped according to orders. The game has many levels with increasing difficulty!

title: Force Master 3D
description: Force Master 3D is a battle Math online game for boys for free. In the game, all the enemies are waiting for you at each level. You need to give priority to attacking monsters lower than yourself. The more monsters you attack, the higher your level will be. Be sure to pay attention to your own strength, because only in this way can you not be destroyed by the enemy!

title: G Wagon City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate busy morning streets, managing fuel and realistic traffic. Venture beyond the city to tackle rugged offroad terrain. Stunning morning graphics bring the city and landscapes to life, while unpredictable pedestrians and police chases add excitement. Customize your G-Wagon's look and performance, and enjoy the ride with your loyal dog. Whether evading cops or exploring trails, G-Wagon City Driver offers a thrilling experience.

title: Runic Block Collapse
description: Welcome to 'Runic Block Collapse'! Tap any block to clear connected blocks in a chain reaction. Removing one block costs 250 points. Removing 2 or more blocks earns points, with larger groups earning more per block. Reach the target score to advance. If you fail, start over. Enjoy endless fun!

title: Puzzle Blocks: Fill It Completely
description:
Discover the world of exciting puzzles!

In this game, you have to collect shapes by filling them with blocks of different sizes and configurations. Each task is a unique logical task that requires attention, patience and a strategic approach.
Various difficulty levels - from easy for beginners to difficult for real masters.
Original shapes and blocks - each level is unique.

title: Challenge Your Friends
description: Challenge yourself! With seven different games, you can experience thrilling moments whether you're playing solo or competing against your friends. Drunken Duel, Tug The Table, Stick Duel, Milk The Cow, and many more games are waiting for you! Plus, to make the competition even more fun, you can choose exciting dares to make  the matches unforgettable! For those who prefer solo play, 6 games are ready to keep you entertained! Step into this world of fun and enjoy the thrill of competition!

title: Shoot N Crush
description: Unleash your shooting skills and break bricks in Shoot N Crush. This game is the best choice for your leisure time. Your goal is to shoot with precision and flexibility. Use the bouncing ball to smash a solid brick with precision. Each level has a different objective and difficulty, you need to break these bricks in the smartest way possible.

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: Stickman Guys Defense
description:
Stickman Guys Defense is an action-packed tower defense game where you must protect your base from endless waves of enemies! Command a team of brave stickman warriors, place them strategically, and upgrade their abilities to stop the invasion. From archers to sword fighters, build the ultimate defense and survive each level!

Can you defend your land and become the ultimate Stickman commander?

title: Cat Escape
description: Play Cat Escape, the viral cat puzzle hide-and-seek game now free online! Sneak past guards, dodge traps, and guide your kitty to safety across hundreds of stealth levels. Unlock skins, collect coins, and outsmart enemies in this browser cat game loved worldwide. Want the full mobile experience? Discover more at CatEscapeTheGame.com

title: Bus Jam Escape
description: Bus Jam Escape brings addictive color-matching puzzle action straight to your browser. In this free online game, you’ll guide waiting passengers into buses by matching their colors - no download required. Ideal for fans of casual puzzle and sorting games, Bus Jam Escape delivers crisp graphics, instant play and intuitive click-and-drag controls. Jump into this vibrant web game for quick brain teasers or marathon sessions - every tap pushes you closer to a high-score win.

title: Power Light
description: Move the tiles around until the power can flow freely to the light bulb. Power up the light bulb to complete each level in this fun online puzzle game

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: Phantom thief Cat Running
description: Avoid obstacles and reach the goal! Tap to change direction, and the game ends when your stamina reaches zero. Pick up items to increase your score or restore stamina. Collect three stars to enter Invincible Mode. Fish bones reduce stamina, but collecting ten turns coins into high-scoring diamonds for a short time!

title: Save the Daddy
description:
Get ready to unlock a world of tricky puzzles and brain teasers in Save the Daddy. Each level is unique and carefully designed to challenge your mind and test your IQ. Pull the pin in the right order and help the man escape from dangerous monsters & obstacles safely and thoughtfully.
Play each level very cautiously by analyzing your move before pulling the pin. As you progress, levels increase in difficulty which will make you game challenging and earn more rewards.

title: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Unblock Ball: Slide Puzzle, a classic sliding puzzle game that lets you use your mind.You can feel a sense of accomplishment! Sliding the board to create the channel for the ball to roll smoothly to the end. You should use your logical mind to cleverly move blocks, avoid
obstacles, and solve every puzzle!

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: Spider Evolution
description: Transform into the ultimate spider in Spider Evolution! Start small, grow stronger, and outsmart rivals on a vibrant track. Merge, dodge, and strategize to become the apex arachnid. Experience thrilling hyper-casual gameplay and dominate the spider world!

title: Arcade Rope
description:
Swing between platforms in Arcade Rope! Play free and online in this rope-swinging adventure.
Arcade Rope is a fast-paced and addictive skill game where your goal is to swing from platform to platform using a rope. Perfectly time your swings to avoid falling into the abyss and see how far you can go. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, making it ideal for quick play sessions. Stay alert, react quickly, and master the art of swinging to survive longer.

title: Syder Hyper Drive
description: Syder Hyper Drive is stunt car game, based on futuristic theme. Perform different stunts from varieties of available vehicles, complete missions in this endless game.

title: Merge Blocks 2048 Style!
description: ● A game with a summer atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where cubes fall and merge if they have the same number! Merge as many cubes as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Two Stunt Racers
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning sports car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Rummy 500 Card Game
description:
Features :
- Offline game.
- 3 Super Modes: classic mode, 3 player mode and Speed mode.
- Auto arrange the cards
- Game statistics.
- Easy to play 
- Excellent and fair ai to play with.
- Continue the last game from where you left.
- No login required

title: Mojicon Garden Connect
description: Looking for a relaxing puzzle break? The 6th Mojicon game is here to help you unwind! Mojicon Garden Connect brings the beauty of spring right to your screen. Connect colorful tiles at your own pace and watch the garden come to life. As you play, you'll unlock 20 fun, hidden Discoveries featuring adorable garden friends. Now lighter and smoother than ever, it’s the perfect polished puzzle for your downtime.

title: Drill Quest
description:
Drill Quest is a casual game combining the excitement of crushing blocks, upgrading your drill, and building your city. 

Explore diverse locations, progressively upgrade your equipment, and choose from machines.

title: Color Yarn Sort
description: Color Yarn Sort is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you need to sort colorful spools of yarn into their matching buckets. The challenge? You have limited space to place the buckets, and you must think carefully about which bucket to move forward. Each yarn color must be placed in its corresponding bucket, but you can only move the buckets into the available spaces—there’s no room for error!

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash:
Explore a world where a geometric wave rushes through crazy obstacles, overcoming challenges one after another. Rhythm, chaos, and a splash of Italian madness — test your reaction and endurance in this geometric trial!

On different levels, you’ll encounter various Italian Brainrot animals: Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, Lirili Larila.

title: Garage Master - Nuts and Bolts
description:
Your goal as a Garage Master is to sort out nuts by color to corresponding bolt. Sounds easy, doesn't it? Think twice! The color sort game presents a challenges by mixing all the nuts and making it difficult to find the corresponding bolt.
It’s a perfect time to train your problem-solving abilities in this color sort game.
The best part is when your car is finished, open my super garage and customize it by choosing one of 4 skins.

title: Russian Derby Crash
description:
Russian Derby Crash is a thrilling game that immerses you in the atmosphere of spectacular car racing with elements of destruction. You'll control one of five Russian cars or a tank. Destroy cars on the training ground and unlock new ones!
This game has a unique twist: in addition to cars, there's a tank on the training ground, from which you can shoot at other participants!

title: Power Puzzle
description:
In Power Puzzle, you take control of a growing electrical network. Connect generators, route power through the grid, and bring every building to life — but every move matters.

? Gameplay
Connect power lines from generators to buildings
Manage limited connections and avoid inefficient routes
Every level is a handcrafted puzzle with increasing complexity
Multiple solutions are possible — can you find the most optimal one?

title: Alchemy Puzzle
description:
We create challenges with fun puzzles, challenge your brain and make you always smile on your lips.
Alchemy Puzzle will help you have moments of light entertainment, combined with puzzle play and fun real life characters.
If you've ever played games: puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, brain teasers, or just want to spend time have time to relax, let try Alchemy Puzzle, It's for you.

title: Plane Crash Ragdoll Simulator
description: As a fearless pilot, your mission is simple: survive a relentless onslaught of rockets targeting your aircraft. Take the controls of a variety of planes and helicopters, each with unique skins to unlock and customize. Your goal is to navigate through perilous skies and bring your aircraft to the ground without crashing. But be warned: if you touch the ground, your aircraft will be exploded!

title: Robbie: Stand on the Right Color!
description:
Welcome to the vibrant world of speed and reaction!
You are about to be tested on your attentiveness and lightning-fast decisions. Your task is simple but tricky: step on the right color before the floor disappears beneath your feet!
Suitable for anyone who loves fast, simple, and addictive games.
Are you ready to help Robbie stand his ground?

title: Mahjong Earth
description: Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Mahjong Earth! This captivating game offers a tranquil escape with its soothing earth-themed soundtrack and stunning tile designs. Explore over 250+ unique puzzle layouts, each more challenging than the last. Use the Combo meter to match quickly and earn stars. Climb the leaderboard for recognition and claim boosters by reaching the top. Immerse in the relaxing soundtrack and earthy tiles for a truly calming experience!

title: ChickZ Stack
description:
ChickZ Stack is a fun and addictive arcade game where flying chickens take to the sky! stack your chickens to overcome obstacles and glide through colorful, challenging levels.

The taller your chicken stack, the easier it is to pass walls, traps, and enemies.

Unlock adorable flying chickens, explore new worlds, and compete for high scores.

With simple one-tap controls and fast-paced gameplay, ChickZ Stack is easy to play but hard to master.

Stack, fly, and flap your way to victory!

title: Mahjong Pet Quest
description:
Dive into the colorful and engaging world of Mahjong Pet Quest, a fun and relaxing puzzle game where classic Mahjong meets adorable animal tiles!
Replace the classic Mahjong tiles with cute animal-themed ones! Each tile brings a charming, delightful touch to the game.
Explore a variety of levels, each designed to test your skills and logic. The difficulty increases as you progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged!

title: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge
description: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge is an addictive merge puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merge games. This game is in 3D with crazy fun physics! The squares don't stay in place, they pop up. The gameplay is much simpler. If you like 2048 games and want to play a novel mode, join the game.

title: Otu
description:
In OTU, you control a nimble triangle bound to a circular orbit. Your mission is simple: stay alive as long as possible. But the universe is against you! Spheres close in from the void, shrinking bars attempt to crush you, and lethal rotating lasers force you to keep moving.

Think you’ve mastered the rhythm? Every 10 seconds, the game throws a Random Debuff at you. From screen-shaking earthquakes and inverted controls to pixelated vision and orbit shifts—no two runs are ever the same!

title: Asoka Makeup Indian Bride
description: Immerse yourself in the colorful world of the Indian wedding tradition with Princesses Jacqueline and Eliza! Help them create the perfect wedding look with the help of various cosmetics and accessories. Use bright shadows, radiant blush and long-lasting lipstick to make the princesses look dazzling. Do not forget about the traditional jewelry: nath, earrings and necklace. Complete the image of an Indian bride and help the princesses become the most beautiful on the holiday!

title: Tricky Arrow
description: Get ready to sharpen your skills in Tricky Arrow! Test your precision and reflexes as you shoot arrows at a spinning circle target. Aim for the bullseye and avoid hitting other arrows. With each twist and spin, the challenge grows, requiring strategy and accuracy. Simple yet addictive gameplay for all ages.

title: Chicken Scream Race
description: Get ready for a wacky and challenging voice-controlled adventure in Chicken Scream Race! This unique game brings a hilarious twist to platform racing by letting you control your character with both taps and your voice. Whether you’re clucking quietly or screaming loudly, your chicken responds to the intensity of your sound, making each race a chaotic yet exciting experience.

title: Lights Out
description: Lights Out is a minimalist puzzle platformer with a twist: the level is pitch black. Reveal your surroundings by emitting light, but there's a catch: you can't move while the lights are on. Memorize in the dark to move in the light. Master timing, memory, and reflexes to conquer each world’s unique mechanics.

title: Mojo Match 3D
description: Discover the ultimate Match 3D experience in Mojo Match 3D! Dive into a world where colors collide and puzzles await at every turn.

title: Tappy Bird - Avoid the Spikes
description: Tap on the screen to move bird up, avoiding the spikes as the level progresses more spikes appear and the possibility to collect coins increases.

title: Color Jam 3D
description:
Color Jam 3D is a fun and relaxing match-and-merge puzzle game! Combine crayons of the same colors  to fill the picture and bring stunning images to life with vibrant colors.
With engaging gameplay and satisfying color-filling mechanics, Color Jam 3D offers a unique blend of puzzle-solving and artistic expression.

title: Piggy Clicker
description: Piggy Clicker is a classic Clicker game, where you get to have Piggy as your pet and trough clicking buy him toys and such

title: Face Changes
description: Face Changer is a fun puzzle game in which you have to correctly put together different faces in order to move to the next level or achieve new and better results in the training mode.

title: Family Tree Emoji
description:
Is a logic game that combines the excitement of deciphering with the surprise of bizarre combinations.

The game will come across family trees with missing cells, you need to choose the emoji that fits into that gap.

Look at the parents and children to find commonalities and complete all levels.

title: Energy Factory Idle
description: Energy Factory Idle is a relaxing idle factory game where you build and upgrade your own energy production system. Start with a small generator and turn it into a powerful factory by hiring workers, improving speed and output, and unlocking new generators. Your factory keeps working even while offline, letting you collect rewards and grow step by step. Simple controls, smooth progression, and a calm idle tycoon experience—perfect for short or long play sessions.

title: Italian Brainrot Bomb - 2Player
description: The dynamite bomb is left in the space hangar. Whoever has it when the time runs out wins the game, because the bomb will explode. Take the bomb from your opponent before the time runs out. When the time ends, the player holding the bomb wins. Grab the bomb to win the game. Be very careful — take the bomb and run, and never let the other player have it.

title: Hopnova
description: Hopnova is a fastpaced vertical adventure where every jump takes you closer to the stars. Guide your little explorer across floating platforms, avoid dangers, and discover powerups that boost you higher and higher. Chase new heights, beat your best scores, and enjoy quick, addictive gameplay perfect for short, exciting sessions.

title: Merge Balls New Years Toys in 3D!
description: ● A game with a New Year's atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a play area? where balls fall and connect if they have the same color! Connect as many balls as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Obby Draw to Escape
description:
Have a blast in Obby illustrating your way to victory! Play the fun and relaxing casual game Draw to Escape and see if you can overcome the levels' issues using just your creativity.

You may earn money as you go through the levels, and you can earn even more coins when you reach the end of each level for every star you find. Things may vanish or explode and kill you, so be sure to check every level thoroughly.

title: Remove the Evidence
description: You’re not just solving puzzles—you’re covering your tracks! Step into the shoes of a hilariously clumsy criminal mastermind who always gets the job done but never without leaving a trail of chaos behind. Your mission? Clean up your mess before the authorities arrive!

title: Bubble Tea
description: Bubble Tea – Color Game is all about mixing and matching and blending and fusing a huge assortment of flavors and colors to create cold drink concoctions that will have you licking your lips. Receive orders, choose the right ingredients, pour them all into a cup, and serve to your thirsty customers. Take care not to spill your drinks in the excitement!

title: Shiny Jewels
description: Conquer each level with your logic, unleash powerful boosters and claim victory! Complete missions to earn unique rewards or join special events: break the chest, collect as many coins as possible within limited moves or race against time to complete the level.

title: Minecraft Battle Party
description: Ready for a hot feast of square battles? In Minecraft Battle Party, you'll enter a pixel-styled battle arena where nervous fighting meets iconic Minecraft-style visuals. In this world, every game is a duel to the death. You will play different roles and use different weapons. For example, as a gunner, constantly move your character so that enemies are shot within your scanning range. Watch out for other people's attacks.

title: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles!
description: Battle hordes of Minecraft mobs! Buy awesome swords and helmets, or unbox them from cases. Take on mega-bosses, unlock different modes, and earn leaderboard points to become the best in this game!

title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
description: Test your makeup artist skills in Dazzling Divas Makeup! Inspired by My Little Pony, this colorful dress-up game lets you create magical makeup looks for three fabulous girls—Lila, Mimi, and Roxy. Style each diva with Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, and Rainbow Dash–inspired makeup, then complete their look with trendy tops and accessories. With endless outfit combos and sparkling vibes, this is the ultimate glam experience for fashion lovers!

title: Frogtastic Marble Adventure
description:
Get ready to dive into a world of colors and adrenaline with Frogtastic, the puzzle game that will keep you glued to the screen! Jump into the adventure and save your world from the invasion of colorful spheres by combining strategy and lightning-fast reflexes!

Endless fun! Whether you have a few minutes for a quick game or want to dive into long gaming sessions, Frogtastic is perfect for you.

Play now and experience a puzzle game you won’t forget!

title: Monster High Spooky Fashion
description: In Monster High Spooky Fashion, step into the world of ghouls and ghosts as you style your favorite Monster High characters! Choose spooky outfits, eerie accessories, and haunting makeup to create the ultimate creepy-cool look. Mix and match from a wide range of outfits to give each character a unique spooky style perfect for any Monster High event. Whether it’s for a Halloween party or a night out in the graveyard, bring out your inner fashionista with Halloween Spooky Fashion!

title: Associations
description:
Find Associations between words!

There are many different levels waiting for you with no time limit. No rush, just an exciting game that will help you relax and unwind.

This game is suitable for those who want to test their wits in this interesting puzzle game!

The game will definitely interest you if you like "Wordle", "Mahjong", "Guess the words", "2048", "Nonograms", "Crosswords", "Filwords", "Three in a row", "Puzzles", "Reagents".

Have a nice game!

description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

description: Ride in the most awesome environment of this best superbike simulator 2024 which is designed especially for performing the craziest bike tricks and stunts to win amazing prizes in this Extreme Motorbike Simulator Game. the realistic physics of fast motorcycle and a lot of options to choose between different motorbikes give you unlimited fun in Extreme Motorbike Simulator 3d.
